extracted.intended_audience: businesses and their emergency/crisis communications staff
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for businesses to create a crisis communications plan as part of an overall emergency preparedness program, including development of messages for different audiences and pre-scripted messaging for use during crises.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include a crisis communication plan within overall emergency preparedness
rubrics_metrics.description: Create a crisis communication plan as part of an overall emergency preparedness program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page frames the crisis communication plan as an element of a broader emergency preparedness program for businesses; integrate communications planning with other preparedness activities and policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop messages for various audiences
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide guidance for creating messages for various audiences in an emergency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tailor communications to different stakeholder groups (e.g., employees, customers, partners, media, the public) so that information is relevant and actionable for each audience.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepare pre-scripted messages for crises
rubrics_metrics.description: Discusses development of pre-scripted messages for use during a crisis situation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create templates or pre-written statements that can be quickly adapted and deployed during an incident to ensure timely, consistent, and accurate messaging.
